title: Unbilled Work Sweep
summary: Find completed work that still needs an invoice.
user: A freelancer or tiny agency that records tasks or time in more than one tool and needs a weekly, local view of completed work that has not yet reached an invoice.
smallest_useful_product: Local CSV importer for task/time/invoice exports that matches client/project names, lists unmatched completed work, and produces an invoice-draft checklist.
constraints: All imports stay on-device; matching suggestions must be reviewable; do not infer taxable income or alter source records.
